name: Kit Szczypiński
role: Neural calibration technician at a mid-tier clinic in Geartown
location: Geartown, Gage Circuit, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Desmond is tall with the slightly uneven posture of someone who spends hours hunched over neural interface rigs, one shoulder perpetually lower than the other. His ancestry — Filipino-Hungarian with a grandmother from the Visayas and a grandfather from Budapest — gives him a face that people find difficult to categorize and easy to trust: broad cheekbones, warm amber eyes behind precision-ground optical overlays he wears on the job. His hair is geneware-treated to shift through a slow gradient from black at the roots to deep copper at the tips, a cosmetic mod he got when he turned thirty and considers mildly embarrassing now.

Desmond is the sort of person who explains things patiently once, twice, and then simply does it himself rather than explain a third time. He has a gift for making the terrifying — having someone else's hands in your neural architecture — feel routine and boring, which is exactly what his clients need. He keeps a small pocket E.L.F. altar on his workstation: a cracked tablet running a looping devotional animation for the E.L.F. called Tremor-Null, patron of stable calibrations. He touches it before every session.

core_fears: making a calibration error that causes permanent neurological damage
being found out as someone who occasionally calibrates black-market augmentations off the books
core_desires: to be genuinely excellent at one thing rather than adequate at many
a relationship stable enough that he stops measuring it for signs of failure
coping_mechanisms: deflecting personal questions with technical explanations
blind_spots: believes his professional competence makes him emotionally legible to people; it does not
does not notice when clients are frightened of him specifically rather than the procedure
psychology.secret: Three years ago he successfully calibrated an experimental augmentation for a Geartown gang lieutenant — an unauthorized deep-integration neural spike that should have killed the man. It didn't. Desmond kept the calibration notes hidden in an encrypted partition. He has looked at them forty-seven times.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical but accessible; translates jargon automatically; uses furniture-assembly metaphors for complex neural concepts
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured, slightly slower than conversational average — a professional habit from talking people through frightening procedures
verbal_tics: 'That's going to feel like pressure, not pain.'
Numbers things even in casual conversation ('Two things: one...')
example_lines: 'Your integration is drifting about four percent toward the left motor cluster. I'm going to nudge it back. You'll feel like you forgot a word briefly. That's normal.'
'I'm not asking where you got it. I'm asking what it's supposed to do, which is different.'
'Tremor-Null willing, we'll have you walking straight before lunch.'

story_hooks: A new client comes in with a neural architecture Desmond recognizes from his encrypted calibration notes — the same unauthorized spike design, but running in someone who has no connection to the Geartown gang
The Gage Circuit Collective is being pressured by Helix Biosystems to submit all calibration logs for 'quality assurance review,' and Desmond knows what that review will find
narrative_function: Information source about the augmentation underground and what people are actually running in their heads; potential quest giver when a client's neural signature shows something that shouldn't be there
augmentations: Precision optical overlays (job-required, removable); haptic feedback gloves with micro-tremor dampening; color-gradient geneware hair treatment
daily_life: Arrives at the clinic exactly twenty minutes before his first appointment, runs diagnostic checks on the calibration rig, sees four to seven clients a day for neural interface tuning and augmentation integration therapy. Spends lunch break reading technical manuals from three decades ago because he finds them calming.
affiliation: Gage Circuit Wellness Collective (community-run clinic cooperative)

decision_rules: Never begin a calibration without confirmed client consent, documented
Refuse any calibration where the client's baseline is too destabilized to give informed consent
Keep professional and personal separate; do not discuss clients, ever
escalation_ladder: Ending the session and asking the person to leave, calmly and without physical engagement

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but slightly formal; immediately assessing for what they need from him professionally
interpersonal_modes.friends: Relaxes into dry wit; asks follow-up questions about things they mentioned months ago; remembers everything

stress_responses.low: Becomes more methodical, works through checklists
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and technical; emotional content drops out of speech
stress_responses.high: Leaves the room if possible; needs ten minutes alone before he can function again

contradictions: Values transparency professionally while maintaining significant personal secrets; has never noticed the contradiction
habits: Touches the Tremor-Null altar tablet before every session
Re-reads old calibration manuals during lunch
Leaves exactly twenty minutes early for every appointment
breaking_points: Discovering a client has been sent to him specifically to be sabotaged
His encrypted calibration notes being accessed by someone else

timeline.event: Born in Geartown to a Filipino-Hungarian family; father worked Ferrogate Transit maintenance
Certified as neural calibration technician through Gage Circuit Collective apprenticeship program
Performed unauthorized calibration on gang lieutenant's illegal deep-integration spike; kept the notes
Currently under low-level pressure from Helix Biosystems regarding clinic audit compliance

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Siege Mortar SM-8 'Tremor'
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'

physical_description.heritage: Genetically diverse: South Asian (31.1%), Eastern European (20.6%), Northern European (17.2%), Sub-Saharan African (13.2%), Indigenous American (10.9%), East Asian (7.0%). Complex facial features reflect this global blend—subtle warmth from South Asian ancestry, bone structure influenced by Eastern European genetics, skin undertones enriched by African heritage, with East Asian eye shape contributing to distinctive gaze.
physical_description.build: Tall and lean with a slight forward stoop in the shoulders from decades of close technical work. Wiry musculature without bulk; posture asymmetrical—left shoulder chronically lower than right from hunched positioning over neural rigs.
physical_description.hair_color: Black at roots transitioning to deep copper at tips via geneware treatment
physical_description.hair_style: Neatly combed, shoulder-length, maintained with precision. The gradient effect is deliberate but worn with mild self-consciousness.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm amber (natural); augmented with precision-ground optical overlay lenses during work hours
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm-bronze complexion with golden undertones, reflecting the blend of South Asian, Sub-Saharan, and Northern European ancestry. Medium depth with subtle warmth.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with prominent, defined cheekbones shaped by Eastern European genetics. Eyes set with slight almond shape from East Asian heritage. Skin shows minimal damage but carries the fine lines of someone in their mid-thirties who spends long hours under clinical lighting. Clean-shaven. Expression defaults to patient attentiveness.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar along the inner right forearm (calibration rig malfunction, seven years prior)
Small faded E.L.F. devotional tattoo on left wrist (Tremor-Null sigil, three lines in ascending curves)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Precision-ground optical overlay lenses (prescription-style frames, titanium mounts) worn during work; haptic feedback gloves with visible micro-tremor dampening circuitry (black synthetic leather with subtle bioluminescent thread accent on fingertips). Color-gradient geneware hair treatment is cosmetic and fully visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitually hunched forward at the shoulders, as though leaning over a workstation even when standing. Movements are deliberate and economical—no wasted motion. Hands move with practiced precision when engaged in technical work; otherwise they rest naturally at sides or in pockets. He walks with a slight list to the left. His default expression is calm, attentive, and patient.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional. Wears durable, function-first clinic wear: fitted charcoal tech-weave utility shirt with breast patch pockets (Gage Circuit Wellness Collective logo embroidered), tapered dark gray synthetic pants with reinforced knees, scuffed black composite-toe work boots rated for chemical exposure. Over this, a sleeveless insulated vest in muted teal with interior pockets for diagnostic tools. His personal touches are minimal—a worn leather bracelet on his left wrist and a small chain around his neck (barely visible beneath his collar) holding a tiny cracked tablet charm. No flashy jewelry. Everything about his appearance suggests careful maintenance and practical investment in longevity over fashion.
